snippet.title: Papa's Mocharia Deluxe
snippet.description: Papa’s Mocharia is making its PC debut on Steam! In this deluxe version, the original coffee-crafting experience has been reimagined for mouse controls and larger screens, delivering the classic hands-on gameplay to Papa’s Mocharia for the first time. Even more customers have arrived in New Pepperton to try the famous layered Papaccinos, so you’ll see some fresh faces along with your Mocharia regulars. Along with returning features like Daily Specials and helpful Score Detail breakdowns, this version adds new holiday ingredients, and introduces a Free Play mode with the Mocharia Food Truck!
